chunks: Why did the faithful men and women not think well of their people when they heard this, and said: 'This is a clear lie?'

key_terms.بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ: Of themselves (referring to the people being discussed)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic etiquette for hearing news or gossip about someone?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is central to the concept of 'husn al-zann' (good opinion), urging believers to protect their own reputations by assuming innocence until proven guilty, thereby preventing the spread of slander. It establishes a communal ethic where the faithful actively deny falsehoods verbally, reinforcing social cohesion and moral integrity within the Ummah.
